neighbours.label: Preposition that introduces the counterparty of a formal agreement or tie (signed a memorandum/agreement … with; an accord between X and Y); spatial 'between' and instrumental 'with' stay quiet
fire: The port authority signed a memorandum of understanding with a Dutch shipping company.
A cooperation agreement between the two universities was signed in March.
The energy ministry concluded a memorandum of understanding with a Korean utility.
The treaty between the kingdom and its northern neighbour was ratified last year.
The airline signed a codeshare agreement with a carrier based in Doha.
A memorandum of understanding between the hospital and the medical school took effect today.
The city signed a twinning agreement with a town in southern France.
The trade pact between the island and the mainland was renewed for five years.
quiet: The port authority painted the old warehouse with a bright blue colour.
A narrow footpath between the two fields was flooded in March.
The energy ministry moved to a new building with a large car park.
The road between the castle and the northern gate was repaired last year.
The airline served the meal with a small bottle of water.
A wooden fence between the hospital and the school fell down today.
The city decorated the main square with lights and flags.
The distance between the island and the mainland is five kilometres.

notes: Card: ' between', Arabic ' مع' (with), 'entre', Korean object marker before 'partnership', all linking parties of a relationship; logits suppress collaboration/partnership/cooperation. Probes: memorandum of understanding with 0.49, agreement between 0.29, partnership with 0.15, relationship with 0.11; spatial/instrumental 0.01-0.05.
